note: Directory, not endorsement. Descriptions are GoldBrief's own plain-language summaries; check each site's own terms, privacy practices and current content. Third-party skills and code should be read before you run them.

items.name: skills.sh
items.what: A public directory and leaderboard of reusable 'agent skills'. Its homepage describes installing a skill with the command npx skills add <owner/repo>.
items.note: Skills are instructions and scripts that run with your agent's access. Review a skill's source before installing it.

items.name: Agent Skills specification
items.what: Documentation for the open format used to package skills for AI agents.

items.name: Model Context Protocol
items.what: Documentation for MCP, an open protocol for connecting AI applications to tools and data sources.

items.name: Elements of AI
items.what: Free introductory online course on what AI is and is not, aimed at non-specialists.

items.name: Google Machine Learning Crash Course
items.what: Free self-paced introduction to machine learning concepts with exercises.

items.name: Hugging Face Learn
items.what: Free courses on language models, agents and related tooling.

items.name: fast.ai
items.what: Practical deep-learning teaching material and community.

items.name: Stanford AI Index
items.what: Annual report compiling research, industry and policy data on AI.

items.name: Epoch AI
items.what: Research organization publishing datasets and analysis on AI trends such as compute and training scale.

items.name: LMArena
items.note: Preference votes are one signal; they are not a measure of accuracy or safety.

items.name: OECD.AI Policy Observatory
items.what: International AI policy, incidents and country data.

items.name: AI Incident Database
items.what: Searchable collection of reports of real-world AI harms and failures.

items.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
items.what: U.S. government voluntary framework for managing AI risk.
